versions.changelog: v2.3 quality enhancement - security audit + marketing packaging + slug-content validation

Initial release of 网页抓取引擎 (web-scraper-engine):

- Provides end-to-end web data scraping based on Firecrawl, Playwright, and Crawl4AI.
- Features structured extraction, multi-step browser automation (click, form, pagination, login), batch/async crawling, and data export (CSV/JSON/Parquet).
- Supports Chinese interaction, flexible configuration, easy setup, and built-in error handling.
- Enables both quick single-page scraping and complex workflows, with examples for price monitoring, news extraction, and form interactions.
- Offers clear limitations: not for large-scale distributed crawling, real-time streams, mobile apps, or breaking site protections.
